gating_notes.value: Requires a Help Scout account (free trial works) and an OAuth app or API key tied to an active invited user.
gating_notes.quote: All credentials must be associated with an active, invited user in the Help Scout account; a 401 error will be returned if a user does not meet these credentials.

oauth_details.value: Supports Authorization Code flow (user‑redirect) and Client Credentials flow (internal). Tokens are sent via the Authorization: Bearer header.
oauth_details.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization, implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.
